# foldercreate

Creates a folder. *(version 4.69 or later)*

```ttl
foldercreate <foldername>
```

## Remarks

Creates a new folder specified by &lt;foldername&gt;.
If the folder is created successfully, the system variable "result" is set to 0. Otherwise, "result" is set to non-zero.

## Example

```ttl
foldercreate 'data'
```
